_description: L 98-59 d, temperate super-Earth, primary target for IGRINS/EXoPLORE analysis
_references: Demangeon et al. 2021, A&A 653, A41, orbital/planetary/stellar parameters (Table 3 and Table A.2)
Schwarz et al. 2025, arXiv:2507.06413, T_eq = 414 K (Table C2); supersedes Demangeon+21 value of 416 K
Gressier et al. 2024, updated mid-transit epoch T0 (via Cheverall et al. 2026 Table 1)
Cheverall et al. 2026, MNRAS, IGRINS analysis; Kp derived from orbital params; limb darkening q1/q2 from exoctk (Bourque et al. 2021) converted to u1/u2 via Kipping 2013
v_rotsini: Demangeon+21 assume 1 km/s for Rossiter-McLaughlin estimate (Appendix A.1.1 gives sqrt(zeta^2 + vsini^2)=3.78 km/s; vsini not independently resolved)
name: L9859d
_note_kp: Kp derived from orbital parameters following Cheverall+26 Eq.: Kp = (2piG/P)^1/3 * Mstar * sin(i) / (Mp+Mstar)^2/3 / sqrt(1-e^2)
_note_ks: Kstar = 1.5125 m/s derived from same formula with Mp instead of Mstar
_note_teq: T_eq = 414 K from Schwarz et al. 2025 (arXiv:2507.06413 Table C2); Demangeon+21 gave 416 K, Cheverall+26 used 300 K (incorrect underestimate)
_note_ld: Cheverall+26 Table 1 gives Kipping (2013) parametrization q1=0.09, q2=0.214 from exoctk. Converted: u1 = 2*sqrt(q1)*q2, u2 = sqrt(q1)*(1-2*q2)
